claim: Amy Coney Barrett was confirmed as US Supreme Court Justice on October 26, 2020

sub_claims.question: Was Amy Coney Barrett confirmed as a US Supreme Court Justice?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, Amy Coney Barrett was confirmed by the US Senate to serve as an Associate Justice of the Supreme Court in 2020. I am very confident.

evidence.statement: Amy Coney Barrett was confirmed by the United States Senate as an Associate Justice of the Supreme Court in 2020.

sub_claims.question: Was Amy Coney Barrett confirmed on October 26, 2020?
sub_claims.answer: Yes, the Senate confirmation vote for Amy Coney Barrett took place on October 26, 2020. I am highly confident.

evidence.statement: The Senate confirmation vote for Amy Coney Barrett was held on October 26, 2020.
